open_points.subject: MultipartFileBody.read
open_points.text: MUST answer the next bytes of the file part, at most size of them, size being passed positionally
open_points.other_text: it MUST answer empty bytes only once the delimiter has been reached, and on every later call.
open_points.question: For size equal to zero before the delimiter is reached, the first passage requires an empty result while the second forbids it; specify which behavior must change.

open_points.subject: read_upload_head
open_points.text: read_upload_head: [BEHAVIOR] MUST read the head through stream.read alone, asking each time for no byte past the end of the second part's headers, so that the first byte of the file is never read, and at most the imported UPLOAD_FORM_HEAD_MAX_BYTES constant in all: the boundary is the boundary parameter of content_type's multipart form data media type; the first part MUST be the form field the imported OWNER_CSRF_FIELD constant names, with no file name, whose value read as UTF-8 text is the CSRF value; the second part's headers MUST name a file by a filename parameter, an empty one included.
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Replace the dotted stream.read expression with prose naming the declared ByteStream read operation without method-call or dotted-navigation syntax.

open_points.subject: read_upload_head
open_points.text: read_upload_head: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST answer an UploadHead whose three fields are None, stopping its reading there and raising nothing, when content_type is None or names no multipart form data with a boundary, when the first part is not that CSRF field or its value is not UTF-8, when no second part naming a file follows, when the head does not end within the imported UPLOAD_FORM_HEAD_MAX_BYTES constant, when declared_length is less than the head and the closing delimiter, or when stream.read raises or answers empty bytes before the head ends.
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Replace the dotted stream.read expression with prose referring to failure or exhaustion of the declared ByteStream read operation.

open_points.subject: MultipartFileBody.read
open_points.text: MultipartFileBody.read: [BEHAVIOR] MUST answer the next bytes of the file part, at most size of them, size being passed positionally, reading stream only through stream.read and never answering a byte of delimiter or after it; it MUST hold, read and not yet answered, no more bytes than the delimiter's length, MUST call stream.read only while it holds fewer bytes than that, and each such call MUST ask for the delimiter's length less the bytes it holds, never for fewer, so that the file is read in pieces as long as the delimiter allows and not one byte at a time; it MUST answer empty bytes only once the delimiter has been reached, and on every later call.
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Rewrite the requirement without stream.read dotted navigation, method-call instructions, or expression-like call-size calculations.

open_points.subject: MultipartFileBody.read
open_points.text: MultipartFileBody.read: [BEHAVIOR] MUST answer the next bytes of the file part, at most size of them, size being passed positionally, reading stream only through stream.read and never answering a byte of delimiter or after it; it MUST hold, read and not yet answered, no more bytes than the delimiter's length, MUST call stream.read only while it holds fewer bytes than that, and each such call MUST ask for the delimiter's length less the bytes it holds, never for fewer, so that the file is read in pieces as long as the delimiter allows and not one byte at a time; it MUST answer empty bytes only once the delimiter has been reached, and on every later call.
open_points.rule: Реализацию: не пиши алгоритм построчно, пиши требования к поведению
open_points.question: Replace the prescribed buffering and call-by-call algorithm with observable behavioral requirements, placing any required implementation policy behind an imported symbol or declared port.

open_points.subject: MultipartFileBody.read
open_points.text: MultipartFileBody.read: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise ValueError to its caller, answering none of the bytes held, when stream.read raises or answers empty bytes before the delimiter is reached, so that a file part without its closing delimiter is never taken for a whole file.
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Replace the dotted stream.read expression with prose referring to failure or exhaustion of the declared ByteStream read operation.

open_points.subject: read_upload_head
open_points.text: as delimiter a carriage return, a line feed, two hyphens and the boundary, and as file_declared_length declared_length less the bytes of the head it read and less those of the delimiter followed by two hyphens, a carriage return and a line feed
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: Move the delimiter framing and closing-suffix values into imported provider constants and name those constants in the note instead of embedding their values in prose.
